inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted, H1 FY2026 interim (30 Jun 2026). Shares in issue ~10,827m after the Feb-2026 cancellation of 67.4m repurchased shares and H1 option exercises (share capital RMB198.9m -> RMB198.0m), less 63.2m treasury shares = ~10,764m outstanding; plus 229m dilutive options (treasury-stock method) and 38m converted ZEEKR award shares from the H1 FY2026 diluted-EPS note = ~11,030m (H1 weighted diluted 11,073m). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. The FY2025 jump from 10,075m to 10,898m was ZEEKR-privatisation consideration shares (genuine non-SBC issuance), already inside the base count.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement, 'Equity settled share-based payments' RMB1,181,265k (note 40). No net-share-settlement tax withholding line (EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every year). H1 FY2026 SBC RMB222m (0.13% of revenue).
inputs.fx_note: Statements are RMB'000 throughout (the worksheet's HKD tag was wrong); HKEX quote is HKD. All flows, net cash and bridge items are in RMB millions; per-share values convert CNY->HKD at 1.1721 HKD per CNY (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-10T03:38Z; 5-day range 1.1701-1.1721). Direction check from the company's own conversions: the H1 FY2026 buyback of HK$760.0m was booked as RMB682.4m (1.114, Jan-Jun 2026 rates) and the HK$0.50 final dividend on ~10.81bn shares as RMB4,657m (1.160) -- both HKD-per-CNY > 1, matching the direction used. No A-share or ADR dual listing exists for a price parity check.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10y CGB ~1.85% + beta 1.3 (Chinese auto OEM in a price war, operating leverage) x 6.0% ERP = ~9.65%; the company is net cash so WACC ~ cost of equity, rounded to 9.5%. Same WACC in all three scenarios -- cyclicality, price-war and tariff risk live in the scenario flows and weights, not in a stacked premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: FY2025 lease cash = principal RMB1,666.8m + interest RMB137.5m = RMB1,804m (0.52% of revenue; H1 FY2026 ~0.50%) charged via lease_cost_pct_path. Lease liabilities (RMB4,249m at 30 Jun 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt. da_pct_path is D&A ex right-of-use depreciation (~4.2% vs 4.6% reported) so the lease is not charged twice in cash-tax EBIT.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are 100%-consolidated; NCI is charged once in the bridge at book (RMB1,284m at 30 Jun 2026) plus the RMB561m dividend payable to NCI. NCI shrank from RMB7.45bn to RMB1.2bn after the ZEEKR privatisation (Dec-2025) and NCI share of profit is currently a small loss, so book is a fair proxy.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component route) with the non-US/cyclical adaptations -- Geely is an operating automaker, not a holdco. The JV/associate web (Horse Powertrain, Genius AFC auto-finance, Qianli Intelligent Driving, InfiMotion-related stakes, PROTON, Renault Korea, Renault Brazil 21.29%) is equity-accounted and outside consolidated EBITDA, so per the matching-asset rule it enters the bridge as an asset (equity_bridge) rather than as a separate sum-of-parts model. ANCHORS: price HK$15.13 at the 2026-10-09 close; net cash at 30 Jun 2026 = bank balances RMB59,362m + FVTPL wealth-management products RMB5,404m - bank borrowings RMB3,238m - bonds RMB5,500m = RMB56,028m net cash. Restricted bank deposits (RMB4,791m) excluded as pledged against notes payable. The FY2025 final dividend (RMB4,657m) was a liability at 30 Jun and paid in July 2026, so it is deducted in the bridge. EBITDA BASIS: 'operating profit before working-capital changes' from the cash flow statement (FY2025 RMB33,036m = 9.57% of revenue; H1 FY2026 RMB18,779m = 10.82%) -- this is pre-SBC, pre-IFRS16 lease cost, and excludes share of JV/associate results, FX gains and disposal gains, unlike the company's reported EBITDA (RMB31,791m, which includes other items). RESTATEMENT: FY2025's report restated FY2021-24 for the common-control acquisitions of LYNK & CO and dealer entities (merger accounting); FY2024 revenue 240.2bn as filed vs 275.9bn restated. Growth is judged on the RESTATED series (FY2024->FY2025 +25.1% like-for-like, not +43.7% as filed; restated FY2021-25 CAGR 23.1%) and on H1 FY2026 vs restated H1 FY2025 (+14.7%). WORKING CAPITAL: FY2025 OCF (RMB47.3bn) carried an RMB18.3bn working-capital inflow (receivables -10.8bn, payables +8.8bn) and FY2024 restated another +15.3bn; the component build does NOT carry these forward. Geely runs structurally negative working capital (~-RMB79bn at 30 Jun 2026: trade+notes+other receivables + inventory 104.5bn vs trade+notes+other payables 183.6bn, ~-21% of revenue), so growth genuinely releases cash, but the June-2025 60-day supplier-payment commitment and MIIT pressure cap how much of that float can grow: base wc_capture +10% of revenue change (half the structural ratio), bull +15%, bear -5%. CAPEX includes capitalised R&D (PPE + intangible additions, matching Geely's own capex definition); FY2026 guidance ~RMB16bn. BUYBACKS: HK$2.3bn programme (Oct-2025) -- RMB349.7m in FY2025, RMB682.4m cancelled-shares plus RMB991.6m treasury shares in H1 FY2026; the flat count is being funded by a repurchaser. INTEREST INCOME: classified in investing activities (interest received RMB748m FY2025), so reported OCF/FCF already excludes it and the deduction is 0 -- the net-cash pile is counted only once, in the bridge. last_fcf (RMB28.2bn) is the strict reported-FCF-less-SBC figure and is WC-flattered; the component-built owner FCF ex working capital was RMB8.1bn in FY2025 (cash EBITDA 33.0bn - SBC 1.2 - lease cash 1.8 - tax paid 4.0 - capex 17.9; 2.3% of revenue) and RMB8.0bn in H1 FY2026 alone (4.6%, seasonally strong half, capex back to guidance). Base year 1 models 4.0% ex WC (5.0% with the +10% WC capture): the step-up from FY2025 is the guided capex fall (5.2% -> 4.2% of revenue) plus +0.6pp EBITDA margin, both already visible in H1 FY2026. BAND: SBC is only ~0.3% of revenue, so the house/street band is ~HK$1.7 wide and the price sits far below it; the large negative band_position says the market is discounting the business, not the SBC treatment. SANITY: at HK$15.13 the market cap is ~RMB142bn against ~RMB81bn of net cash plus JV stakes net of bridge deductions, implying ~3x year-1 owner FCF for the auto business. That gap is mostly the market discounting the supplier float behind the net cash and the price war. It is not a modelling error, but it is the main thing to check before acting on the upside.

equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet: JVs RMB24,973m + associates RMB14,983m = RMB39,956m, taken at 80% (minority, illiquid, partner-controlled stakes; ~6% return on book from FY2025 share of results RMB2.4bn). Their income is excluded from the EBITDA basis, so the asset enters here once.
H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet, 30 Jun 2026

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (7.7% 5y) diverges far more than 30% from revenue (30.2% as filed, 23.1% restated) and EPS (24.4% 5y). Revenue growth is inflated by acquisitions (ZEEKR, LYNK & CO, dealer entities) paid for partly in cash and shares, and equity was depressed by the ZEEKR privatisation cash-out and dividends. EPS 3y CAGR (48.4%) runs off a trough FY2022 base and FY2024 includes a RMB9.4bn Horse Powertrain deemed-disposal gain. Neither revenue nor EPS CAGR is a usable forward rate; the driver path is built from FY2026 guidance (3.45m units, +14% volume) and H1 FY2026 (+14.7% like-for-like), decelerating.
historical_growth.notes: As-filed revenue: FY2020 92.1bn, FY2022 148.0bn, FY2025 345.2bn RMB. Restated: FY2021 150.2bn, FY2022 163.2bn, FY2024 275.9bn. Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC (interest income sits in investing activities, so no deduction): FY2020 -5.45bn, FY2022 4.19bn, FY2025 28.17bn; the 5y CAGR is undefined off a negative base. The SBC-adjusted FCF CAGR is ABOVE reported because SBC fell from RMB1.49bn (FY2022) to RMB1.18bn while FCF grew. Both FCF CAGRs are dominated by working-capital inflows (FY2025 +RMB18.3bn) and must not be read as an earnings-power trend.

base.growth_rates_rationale: FY2026: H1 revenue +14.7% vs restated H1 FY2025 and a 3.45m-unit (+14%) volume target, but H2 laps a strong H2 FY2025 (RMB194.9bn), domestic volume fell 22.6% in H1 and Sept volume was +7% YoY -- 11% implies H2 +9%. Then deceleration as export growth normalises off a high base and China passenger-car volumes plateau.
base.ebitda_margin_path_rationale: FY2025 9.57%, H1 FY2026 10.82% (gross margin 17.9%), H2 seasonally lower. One-Geely procurement/R&D synergies roughly offset by continued price pressure; settles at 10.0% pre-SBC, pre-lease.
base.capex_pct_path_rationale: FY2026 guidance ~RMB16bn on ~RMB383bn revenue = 4.2%, H1 FY2026 gross 4.5%; FY2025 5.2% included catch-up. Long-run 4.5% sits above ex-ROU D&A (4.2%) because the intelligence/AI race keeps capitalised R&D elevated.
base.cash_tax_rate_path_rationale: Cash tax paid / EBIT: FY2025 ~26%, H1 FY2026 ~17%; mix of 25% PRC statutory and 15% high-tech-enterprise subsidiaries.
base.narrative: Geely holds its #2 China position and keeps exports growing, but the price war caps margins near 10% EBITDA.

bull.narrative: Exports compound, One-Geely synergies land, and anti-involution policy stabilises domestic pricing.

bear.narrative: Price war deepens, export growth hits tariff walls, supplier-payment rules shrink the payables float.

scenario_narratives.base: Geely defends its ~11% China share against BYD, Leapmotor, Xiaomi and the Huawei-ecosystem brands while exports carry the growth: FY2026 lands near guidance (revenue +11% on 3.45m units, H2 slower than H1 as domestic volume stays down and the H2 FY2025 base is high), then growth fades to 3% as China passenger-car volume plateaus and export growth normalises off a base already up ~158% in H1 FY2026. The ZEEKR/LYNK & CO integration delivers enough procurement and platform (GEA/SEA) savings to offset continuing discounting, so cash EBITDA holds about 10% -- above FY2025's 9.6%, below H1 FY2026's seasonally strong 10.8%. Capex follows the ~RMB16bn guidance, then sits slightly above D&A as the ADAS/AI race keeps capitalised R&D high. The payables float grows at half its historical ratio to revenue because of the 60-day supplier-payment pledge.
scenario_narratives.bull: Bull: the One-Geely consolidation works as the bull case in the Analysis describes. Exports keep compounding into Latin America (Renault Brazil), Southeast Asia, the Middle East and Australia, the EU tariff regime eases through the price-undertaking talks, and MIIT/SAMR enforcement actually stops below-cost selling at home. Revenue grows 12-13% for two years and 3% by year 10. Higher-ASP intelligent models (G-ASD, ZEEKR 9X, LYNK & CO 900) and shared architectures lift cash EBITDA to 11.5%, still below the 13-16% the as-filed business earned in FY2018-20. Working-capital float grows with revenue at 15% capture.
scenario_narratives.bear: Bear: the analysis's bear points arrive together. The domestic price war gets worse after the NEV purchase-tax break and trade-in subsidies roll back (domestic volume already -22.6% in H1 FY2026), so blended ASP keeps falling. EU anti-subsidy tariffs and possible new tariffs in other markets stall the exports that were offsetting China. Revenue grows 8% in FY2026 because the first half is already booked, falls 3% in FY2027, and then grows only 2% a year. Cash EBITDA compresses to 8% as BYD's battery cost advantage and new entrants squeeze mid-market pricing. Enforcement of the 60-day supplier-payment rule makes growth consume working capital (capture -5%) rather than release it. The scenario does not model a one-off unwind of the ~RMB79bn negative working-capital position. That tail risk sits on top of the bear and is noted in key risks.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25% because domestic volume is already falling (-22.6% H1 FY2026), the price war has survived repeated regulator summons, and the export engine is exposed to a single policy lever (EU/other tariffs). Base 50%: near-term guidance is credible and nine months of the year are in. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs three independent things at once -- tariff relief, domestic price discipline and synergy delivery.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the consolidated auto business on normalised cash EBITDA, deliberately stripping out the FY2024-25 working-capital inflows that make reported FCF look 3x richer than earnings power. Add the large net-cash pile and the equity-accounted JV/associate stakes once, in the bridge. Judge growth on the restated (like-for-like) series so acquired revenue is not projected as organic.
key_risks_to_valuation: Supplier-float unwind: ~RMB79bn of net negative working capital funds much of the RMB56bn net cash; a regulatory forced shortening of payables terms would move cash out of the bridge one-for-one
Domestic price war: each 1pp of cash EBITDA margin is ~RMB3.8bn/yr of pre-tax flow on FY2026 revenue
EU / third-market tariffs on Chinese-built EVs hitting the export growth that offsets domestic decline
JV/associate values taken at 0.8x book (RMB32bn, ~HK$3.4/share): Horse Powertrain, Genius AFC and the Renault stakes are partner-controlled and illiquid
Related-party / common-control transactions with Geely Holding (further asset injections paid in cash or shares) can move the share count and net cash outside this model
FX: CNY/HKD rate is a live input; refresh_price.py does not update fx_rate
